claims.statement: The frozen compact typed ledger preserves the designated canonical state and reference distinctions on the frozen 20-case decompression pack.
claims.scope: Exact frozen case pack, codec, decoder, replay oracle, and revision only.
claims.falsification_condition: A frozen case decodes to a different designated state, applied/rejected reference set, authority status, or oracle answer.

claims.statement: The frozen compact typed ledger substantially reduces visible supplied-state bytes relative to the frozen Raw representation.
claims.scope: Frozen decompression pack; visible packet/state bytes, excluding lifecycle dependencies.
claims.falsification_condition: Recomputed frozen packet totals do not show the recorded byte reduction.

claims.statement: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B did not demonstrate sufficient solver capability on the frozen decompression benchmark to isolate a representation advantage.
claims.scope: Model digest dae161e2..., frozen Protocol v2.1, local runtime, 20 primary cases.
claims.falsification_condition: A valid replication under the same frozen model digest and protocol passes the preregistered Raw capability gate without post-hoc tuning.

claims.statement: A more capable Codex solver stack could recover all frozen benchmark answers from the engineered compressed representation.
claims.scope: Operator-reported history-isolated exploratory run on the same frozen prompts; no tracked sealed artifact in this branch.
claims.falsification_condition: Independent sealed replications with capable preregistered solvers fail specifically from representation loss.

claims.statement: Compressed representations outperform Raw or ordinary Retrieval on reasoning correctness.
claims.scope: Broad representation claim across capable solvers and held-out worlds.
contradicting_evidence: Qwen run was capability-gated; Codex run had a three-condition ceiling.
claims.falsification_condition: Across preregistered capable-solver frontier tests, Compressed is consistently dominated by strong Raw or Retrieval baselines at matched total cost.

claims.statement: Evidence-bound deterministic authority policies can prevent plans and proposed future effects from becoming current canonical state.
claims.scope: Frozen StoryGuard and deterministic replay policies under their explicit schemas.
claims.falsification_condition: A schema-valid planned/predicted/proposed effect enters canonical state without an admitted completion or licensed inference.

claims.statement: Task-reconstructable compression is a useful organizing objective for a memory and representation research system.
claims.scope: Architecture-level claim; not a complete theory of intelligence.
contradicting_evidence: The objective is task-, solver-, and cost-relative and does not solve semantic grounding.
claims.falsification_condition: Well-powered held-out studies show no useful rate-distortion frontier beyond strong serialization, retrieval, and learned-memory baselines.

claims.statement: Frozen ablation can identify representation components whose removal breaks a specified task, solver, and fail-closed representation-contract predicate.
claims.scope: Contract-relative removal effects; not causal-semantic necessity or a universal minimum representation.
contradicting_evidence: Singleton ablation misses interactions and alternative sufficient sets; the reference manifest treats potentially relevant removals as missing unless a validated replacement exists.
claims.falsification_condition: A recorded removal does not change the frozen pass predicate, or the ablation apparatus labels that removal as essential despite observing an admissible passing subset.

claims.statement: Hive can form bidirectional abstractions that reconstruct task-relevant distinctions on unseen cases.
claims.scope: Automatically proposed concepts, locked unseen worlds and task families.
claims.falsification_condition: Learned concepts collapse counterexamples or fail to reproduce necessary distinctions on held-out generators despite adequate solver capability.

claims.statement: Hive representations transfer structurally or causally beyond their training generator and vocabulary.
claims.scope: Locked generator-, structure-, vocabulary-, and domain-heldout splits.
claims.falsification_condition: Gains disappear under symbol permutation, unseen generators, new causal compositions, or counterexamples.

claims.statement: Hive can discover useful representations rather than rely on a handcrafted codec and ontology.
claims.scope: Query-blind candidate discovery using training worlds only, evaluated once on locked heldout tasks.
contradicting_evidence: The current codec, state keys, authority labels, causal preconditions, and gold tasks are human-engineered.
claims.falsification_condition: Automatically proposed representations fail to Pareto-dominate strong engineered, retrieval, summary, and minified-state baselines on untouched worlds after full cost accounting.

claims.statement: Hive can diagnose whether a failure was caused by observation parsing, representation loss, decompression, solver capability, or evaluation.
claims.scope: Controlled layer-specific fault interventions.
claims.falsification_condition: Fault localization is no better than strong baselines or systematically repairs the wrong layer under controlled interventions.

claims.statement: Versioned representation repair can improve implicated failures without regressing locked prior tasks.
claims.scope: Immutable candidates, frozen old/new tests, explicit promotion and rollback.
contradicting_evidence: Current executable repair is a deterministic missing-component heuristic, not learned diagnosis.
claims.falsification_condition: Repair candidates cannot improve induced representation faults without regressions, hidden evidence access, or evaluator changes.

claims.statement: Meta-representations of solver/representation/task failure patterns improve later representation selection or proposal.
claims.scope: Future unseen selection/proposal episodes at matched information and compute.
claims.falsification_condition: Usable meta-profiles do not outperform shuffled/no-meta controls on future heldout episodes.

claims.statement: Improved representations can improve the machinery that discovers still better representations.
claims.scope: Recursive representation improvement on meta-heldout task families with fixed evaluators and matched total resources.
claims.falsification_condition: Across preregistered diverse meta-heldout studies, the improved proposer does not beat a fixed nonrecursive proposer/search after full compute and human-input accounting.

claims.statement: Kingdom is a useful application proving ground for Hive authority, continuity, and intent mechanisms.
claims.scope: Narrative-domain application role; Kingdom does not define Hive.
contradicting_evidence: Longitudinal Kingdom advantage has not yet been demonstrated.
claims.falsification_condition: Kingdom-specific mechanisms fail to maintain authority/continuity under valid longitudinal experiments or cannot map cleanly to generic interfaces.

claims.statement: Hive representations achieve effective compression after schema, ontology, codec, lookup, preprocessing, model, compute, and human-engineering costs are counted.
claims.scope: Cold-start and amortized lifecycle cost under a declared workload.
contradicting_evidence: Full lifecycle and human-semantic costs have not been measured.
claims.falsification_condition: The representation is dominated by Raw/minified/retrieval baselines once unique static and preprocessing costs are included.

claims.statement: Representation results depend materially on solver capability and solver/representation interaction.
claims.scope: Frozen decompression benchmark and future solver-panel replications.
contradicting_evidence: The two solver stacks were not one preregistered replicated panel.
claims.falsification_condition: Replicated solver panels show representation rankings and capability gates invariant to solver capability under matched protocols.

claims.statement: The reference model passes its tracked deterministic authority, replay, provenance, versioning, and rollback tests at the referenced revision.
claims.scope: Exact tracked reference-model tests at the referenced revision; not an exhaustive proof of every documented invariant.
contradicting_evidence: A finite adversarial suite cannot establish that every caller path or documented invariant is exhaustively enforced.
claims.falsification_condition: A deterministic test or counterexample violates a documented invariant at the referenced commit.

claims.statement: The reference pipeline can execute experience-to-repair end to end on one deterministic fixture.
claims.scope: One synthetic demonstration; proves plumbing only.
claims.falsification_condition: The frozen demo cannot reproduce its artifact hashes and expected failure/repair sequence.

claims.statement: The current Hive system automatically discovers domain semantics from raw observations.
claims.scope: Observation-to-event/entity/authority/causal ontology discovery.
contradicting_evidence: Repository and benchmark archaeology show event types, keys, authority, prerequisites, queries, and codec structure are supplied by code and humans.
claims.falsification_condition: This status may change only after a frozen learner constructs these semantics from raw observations and transfers to heldout generators without labels.
